# Allen Park Dental Care

> > Award-winning cosmetic and family dentistry practice in Allen Park, MI, led by Drs. Greg and Joanne Szalai, offering advanced restorative and cosmetic treatments with cutting-edge technology.

Allen Park Dental Care is a full-service dental practice serving the Allen Park and surrounding Detroit area communities. The practice specializes in cosmetic dentistry, family dentistry, and restorative treatments, utilizing advanced diagnostic and treatment technologies like iTero digital scanning, DIAGNOdent cavity detection, and Invisalign clear aligners.
